integrity: Proof and rational checker included; the checker does not by itself establish the infinite prime-gap input.
scientific_limitations: Only the squarefree domain at cubic reciprocal exponent; a prior unindexed exact classification may exist. Nagura's unconditional prime-gap theorem is cited, not reproved.
title: Sixteen exact bands and prime-pattern densities for squarefree reciprocal-cube divisor sums
